intro.zh: 左右两台唱机各放一首歌，中间的混音台决定观众听到什么。先让音乐响起来。
intro.en: Each deck plays one track; the mixer in the middle decides what the crowd hears. First, make some noise.

text.zh: DJ 的工作就是把两首歌无缝接起来。左边是 A 台，右边是 B 台，中间是混音台。
text.en: A DJ joins two songs without a gap. Deck A is on the left, deck B on the right, the mixer sits in between.

text.zh: 按下 A 台的 ▶ 播放键。
text.en: Press ▶ on deck A.

hint.zh: 看 A 台下面那排按钮，中间最大的就是。
hint.en: It’s the big button in the row under deck A.

text.zh: 把 A 台的音量推子（VOL）推到最上面。
text.en: Push deck A’s volume fader (VOL) all the way up.

hint.zh: 在混音台中间，青色那根竖推子。
hint.en: The cyan vertical fader in the middle of the mixer.

text.zh: 拖一下 A 台的转盘，感受它跟着音乐转。然后再按一次 ▶ 暂停。
text.en: Watch the platter spin with the music, then press ▶ again to pause.

intro.zh: 舞曲是按「拍」和「小节」搭起来的。听懂节拍，才知道什么时候动手。
intro.en: Dance music is built from beats and bars. Hear the grid and you’ll know when to move.

text.zh: 播放 A 台，跟着底鼓在心里数「1、2、3、4」。
text.en: Play deck A and count “1, 2, 3, 4” along with the kick drum.

hint.zh: 混音台上的 A 排小灯会跟着拍子一格一格亮。
hint.en: The A row of lights on the mixer steps along with the beat.

text.zh: 舞曲一小节有几拍？
text.en: How many beats are in one bar of dance music?

why.en: Watch the lights — four steps, then repeat.

text.zh: 8 个小节（32 拍）组成一个乐句。波形上的彩色竖线就是乐句的开头。它有什么用？
text.en: Eight bars (32 beats) make a phrase — the coloured lines on the waveform mark where one starts. Why does that matter?

zh: 新的乐句开头，最适合让下一首歌进场
en: A new phrase is the best moment to bring the next song in

why.zh: 在乐句中间换歌，听起来会像绊了一跤。
why.en: Switching mid-phrase sounds like a stumble.

text.zh: 转盘中间的「12.3」这种数字是什么意思？
text.en: What does a number like “12.3” in the middle of the platter mean?

zh: 第 12 小节的第 3 拍

why.zh: 小节.拍，DJ 靠它数乐句。
why.en: Bar.beat — how DJs keep track of phrases.

intro.zh: 两首歌同时在放，交叉推子决定观众听到哪一边。
intro.en: With both decks playing, the crossfader picks which side the crowd hears.

text.zh: 播放 A 台。
text.en: Play deck A.

text.zh: 再播放 B 台——两首歌叠在一起了。
text.en: Now play deck B — both songs at once.

text.zh: 把最下面的交叉推子推到最左：只剩 A。
text.en: Slide the crossfader at the bottom all the way left: only A.

text.zh: 推到最右：只剩 B。
text.en: All the way right: only B.

text.zh: 推回中间，两边一样大。
text.en: Back to the middle — both equally loud.

text.zh: 不用交叉推子也能关掉一边：把 B 台音量推子拉到底。
text.en: You can also silence a side with its channel fader: pull deck B’s volume all the way down.

intro.zh: 每条通道有三个 EQ 旋钮，分别管高音、人声和乐器、低音和底鼓。
intro.en: Each channel has three EQ knobs: highs, the vocal and instrument mids, and the lows where the kick lives.

text.zh: 播放 A 台。
text.en: Play deck A.

text.zh: 把 A 通道的 LOW 旋钮拧到底（按住往下拖）。听，底鼓和贝斯没了。
text.en: Turn channel A’s LOW knob all the way down (drag downward). The kick and bass vanish.

hint.zh: 旋钮都是按住上下拖；双击回到中间。
hint.en: Drag knobs up or down; double-click resets them.

text.zh: 把 LOW 拧回中间（双击也行）。
text.en: Bring LOW back to the middle (double-click works).

text.zh: 再把 HI 拧到底，高音变闷。
text.en: Now turn HI all the way down — the top end goes dull.

text.zh: 把 HI 拧回中间。
text.en: Return HI to the middle.

text.zh: 两首歌的低音同时开着，会怎么样？
text.en: What happens when both songs play their bass at the same time?

zh: 两个底鼓和贝斯打架，糊成一团
en: Two kicks and basslines clash into mud

why.zh: 所以接歌时要「交换低音」——下一课会用到。
why.en: That’s why DJs swap the bass — you’ll use it soon.

intro.zh: 两首歌速度不同，鼓点就会越走越乱。用 TEMPO 推子把它们调到一样快。
intro.en: Two songs at different speeds drift apart. Use the TEMPO fader to make them match.

text.zh: 播放 A 台（120 BPM）。
text.en: Play deck A (120 BPM).

text.zh: 播放 B 台（125 BPM）。听，鼓点在「打架」。
text.en: Play deck B (125 BPM). Hear the kicks galloping?

text.zh: B 比 A 快，要让 B 跟上 A，B 的 TEMPO 推子该往哪边？
text.en: B is faster than A. Which way should B’s TEMPO fader go?

why.en: The higher BPM needs to come down.

text.zh: 拖 B 台的 TEMPO 推子，让 B 的 BPM 读数和 A 相差不到 0.5。
text.en: Drag deck B’s TEMPO fader until its BPM is within 0.5 of deck A.

hint.zh: 拖大概位置，再点一下推子用方向键微调。
hint.en: Drag close, then click the fader and fine-tune with the arrow keys.

text.zh: 速度一样了，拍子也要对齐：播放中拖 B 台转盘，往前推一点或往后拉一点，直到两排小灯同时亮。
text.en: Same tempo — now line up the beats: while B plays, nudge its platter forward or back until both rows of lights flash together.

intro.zh: 三个让你轻松很多的按钮：一键对拍、原地循环、瞬间跳回记号。
intro.en: Three buttons that make life easy: one-press beatmatch, a loop that holds, and markers you can jump to.

text.zh: 播放 A 台。
text.en: Play deck A.

text.zh: 播放 B 台。
text.en: Play deck B.

text.zh: 按 B 台的 SYNC：B 会自动变到 A 的速度，并且把拍子对齐。
text.en: Press SYNC on deck B: it jumps to A’s tempo and lines up the beats.

text.zh: 按 A 台的 LOOP，把当前 4 拍锁成循环——想拖多久拖多久。
text.en: Press LOOP on deck A to lock the current 4 beats into a loop — hold it as long as you like.

text.zh: 按一下 A 台的热点 1 做记号，过一会儿再按一次，瞬间跳回去。
text.en: Tap hot cue 1 on deck A to drop a marker, then tap it again later to jump straight back.

hint.zh: 设过的热点会亮橙色；右键可以清除。
hint.en: Set cues glow orange; right-click clears one.

intro.zh: 最有「现场感」的两招：让音乐像沉到水里，再像从收音机里冒出来；然后亲手搓一段。
intro.en: Two crowd-pleasers: sink the music underwater, pull it out of a radio — then scratch it by hand.

text.zh: 播放 A 台。
text.en: Play deck A.

text.zh: 把 A 通道的 FILTER 往下拧到接近底：音乐像沉到了水里（低通）。
text.en: Turn channel A’s FILTER down near the bottom: the music sinks underwater (low-pass).

text.zh: 再往上拧到接近顶：只剩下细细的高音（高通）。
text.en: Now turn it up near the top: only a thin top end is left (high-pass).

text.zh: 拧回正中间，音乐恢复原样。
text.en: Back to dead centre — the music is whole again.

text.zh: 暂停 A 台。
text.en: Pause deck A.

text.zh: 按住 A 台转盘，来回快速地搓几下——这就是搓碟！
text.en: Grab deck A’s platter and rub it back and forth a few times — that’s a scratch!

hint.zh: 3 秒内来回换 4 次方向就算过。
hint.en: Change direction four times within three seconds.

intro.zh: 把学过的全部串起来：对拍、交换低音、推交叉推子——从 A 顺滑地过渡到 B。
intro.en: Put it all together: match the beat, swap the bass, ride the crossfader — glide from A into B.

text.zh: 播放 A 台，这是正在放的歌。
text.en: Play deck A — the song on air.

text.zh: 先把 B 通道的 LOW 拧到底，免得等会儿两个底鼓打架。
text.en: First turn channel B’s LOW all the way down so the kicks won’t clash.

text.zh: 在乐句开头播放 B 台。
text.en: Start deck B at the top of a phrase.

text.zh: 按 B 台的 SYNC，让两首歌步调一致。
text.en: Press SYNC on deck B so both songs march together.

text.zh: 把交叉推子慢慢推到中间，B 悄悄进场。
text.en: Ease the crossfader to the middle — B slips in.

text.zh: 交换低音第一步：把 A 通道的 LOW 拧到底。
text.en: Bass swap, part one: turn channel A’s LOW all the way down.

text.zh: 第二步：把 B 通道的 LOW 拧回中间——现在是 B 的底鼓在带场子。
text.en: Part two: bring channel B’s LOW back to the middle — B’s kick now drives the room.

text.zh: 把交叉推子推到最右，A 退场。恭喜，你完成了第一次接歌！
text.en: Slide the crossfader fully right and let A bow out. That’s your first mix!
